VARIABLE_NAME.long_name: Name that describes the variable in a figure
VARIABLE_NAME.sdn_parameter_urn: SeaDataNet URN (SDN:{listid}::{termid}) for variables following NVS2.0
VARIABLE_NAME.sdn_uom_urn: SeaDataNet URN (SDN:{listid}::{termid}) for variable units following NVS2.0
VARIABLE_NAME.accepted_units: regex of the accepted units, if true, the units attribute will overwrite the present units attribute.
VARIABLE_NAME.alternative_label: Name to rename the variable. It is the corresponding alternative name on BODC.
VARIABLE_NAME.notes_SV: Add filter not to include SV (sound velocity) in all CTD files as there is not any sound sensor installed on the CTD Rosette (SV was derived from Temperature and salinity mostly). However, it should be included in all MVP and TSG data as sound velocity sensors are installed on them.
VARIABLE_NAME.notes_O2: All O2 units from before the year 2018 has mL/L. Since 2018, the units was updated to uM. All Dissolved Oxygen unit before 2018 should be converted into uM. An apply_function x*44.661 has been added in order to help for the conversion from mL/L to the unit uM, where x is the variable representing the Dissolved Oxygen before 2018.

time.comments: Time is represented in ISO8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-01T12:00:00Z). The time variable is renamed to 'time' for consistency across datasets.

Depth.long_name: Sea Floor Depth Below Sea Surface

Roll.comments: The roll angle is defined as the rotation of the vessel around its longitudinal axis (i.e., the axis that runs from bow to stern). The positive direction is defined as rightward rotation.

vessel_roll.comments: The roll angle is defined as the rotation of the vessel around its longitudinal axis (i.e., the axis that runs from bow to stern). The positive direction is defined as rightward rotation.

Pitch.comments: The pitch angle is defined as the rotation of the vessel around its transverse axis (i.e., the axis that runs from port to starboard). The positive direction is defined as forward rotation.

vessel_pitch.comments: The pitch angle is defined as the rotation of the vessel around its transverse axis (i.e., the axis that runs from port to starboard). The positive direction is defined as forward rotation.

Heave.comments: The heave is defined as the vertical displacement of the vessel in the direction of the local vertical axis.

vessel_heave.comments: The heave is defined as the vertical displacement of the vessel in the direction of the local vertical axis.

Track.comments: The track is defined as the actual path of the vessel over the ground, measured in degrees from true north.
